title: HSK 3.4 · 能力, 压力, 根本, 精彩, 下来
focus: 强 · 能力 · 注意 · 活 · 拍 · 根本 · 目前 · 游戏 · 马 · 存在 · 下来 · 区 · 指 · 精神 · 双 · 目标 · 联系 · 合作 · 因此 · 意义 · 下去 · 力 · 力量 · 失去 · 压力 · 同意 · 本来 · 基本 · 以来 · 地区 · 关注 · 适合 · 从来 · 标准 · 精彩 · 作品 · 准 · 系 · 下面 · 消失
body:
Strength and roots: 力 (strength) appears in four words, 本 (root) in three, and the direction pair 下来 / 下去 / 下面 shows up as well.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 力 | lì | strength, force | 能力, 力, 力量, 压力 |
| 来 | lái | come | 下来, 本来, 以来, 从来 |
| 本 | běn | root, origin (木 tree + mark at the base) | 根本, 本来, 基本 |
| 下 | xià | down, below | 下来, 下去, 下面 |
| 意 | yì | idea, mind | 注意, 意义, 同意 |
| 目 | mù | eye | 目前, 目标 |
| 精 | jīng | refined, essence | 精神, 精彩 |
| 标 | biāo | mark | 目标, 标准 |

## Watch out

- 下来 (toward the speaker) vs 下去 (away from the speaker). After verbs, 下去 means "keep going" (说下去).
- 精神 jīngshén is "spirit, mind"; said jīngshen it means "lively, full of energy".
- 力 lì (strength) vs 刀 dāo (knife).

cards.Example: 他的能力很强。 tā de nénglì hěn qiáng: he's very capable
cards.Notes: 弓 bow + 口 + 虫 insect. Means strong, powerful: 强大 powerful, 强调 emphasise.

cards.Example: 我相信你的能力。 wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ de nénglì: I trust your ability
cards.Notes: 能 can + 力 strength = capability.

cards.Example: 注意安全！ zhùyì ānquán: stay safe!
cards.Notes: 注 pour, focus (氵 water + 主 zhǔ for the sound) + 意 mind = pour your mind into → pay attention.

cards.Example: 鱼还活着。 yú hái huó zhe: the fish is still alive
cards.Notes: 氵 water + 舌 (here a sound part, not "tongue") = lively water → alive. 生活 life, 活动 activity.

cards.Meaning: to pat, clap; to take (a photo), shoot
cards.Example: 帮我拍张照。 bāng wǒ pāi zhāng zhào: take a photo of me
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 白 bái for the sound = pat with the hand.

cards.Example: 我根本不知道。 wǒ gēnběn bù zhīdào: I had no idea at all
cards.Notes: 根 root (木 + 艮 for the sound) + 本 root = the very root → fundamental. 根本不 = not at all.

cards.Example: 目前还不知道。 mùqián hái bù zhīdào: it's not known yet
cards.Notes: 目 eye + 前 front = before your eyes → at present.

cards.Example: 我们玩游戏吧。 wǒmen wán yóuxì ba: let's play a game
cards.Notes: 游 roam, play (氵 water) + 戏 play, show = play → game.

cards.Example: 我喜欢马。 wǒ xǐhuan mǎ: I like horses.
cards.Notes: The sound part in 妈 mā, 吗 ma, 骂 mà, 码 mǎ

cards.Example: 这个问题一直存在。 zhège wèntí yìzhí cúnzài: this problem has always existed
cards.Notes: 存 keep, store + 在 be present = remain present → exist.

cards.Meaning: to come down; (after verb) down, settle
cards.Example: 快下来！ kuài xiàlai: come down here!
cards.Notes: 下 down + 来 come = come down (toward the speaker). After verbs: 停下来 stop, 写下来 write down.

cards.Example: 你住哪个区？ nǐ zhù nǎge qū: which district do you live in?
cards.Notes: 匚 enclosure + 乂 = a marked-off space → area, district.

cards.Meaning: finger; to point at; to refer to
cards.Example: 别用手指人。 bié yòng shǒu zhǐ rén: don't point at people
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 旨 zhǐ for the sound = finger, point. 手指 finger.

cards.Example: 你今天很精神。 nǐ jīntiān hěn jīngshen: you look full of energy today
cards.Notes: 精 essence (米 rice + 青 qīng for the sound) + 神 spirit = mind; said jīngshen = lively.

cards.Example: 一双鞋。 yì shuāng xié: a pair of shoes
cards.Notes: 又 hand + 又 hand = two hands → pair. Classifier for shoes, chopsticks, eyes.

cards.Example: 我的目标是第一。 wǒ de mùbiāo shì dì yī: my goal is first place
cards.Notes: 目 eye + 标 mark (木 + 示) = the mark your eye aims at → target.

cards.Example: 我们保持联系。 wǒmen bǎochí liánxì: let's keep in touch
cards.Notes: 联 join (耳 + 关) + 系 tie = join and tie → connect, contact.

cards.Example: 合作愉快！ hézuò yúkuài: here's to working together!
cards.Notes: 合 combine + 作 do, work = work together.

cards.Example: 他病了，因此没来。 tā bìng le, yīncǐ méi lái: he was ill, so he didn't come
cards.Notes: 因 cause + 此 this = because of this → therefore.

cards.Example: 这件事很有意义。 zhè jiàn shì hěn yǒu yìyì: this is very meaningful
cards.Notes: 意 meaning, idea + 义 sense, right = meaning. Lookalikes: 义 yì, 叉 chā, 又 yòu.

cards.Meaning: to go down; (after verb) to continue
cards.Example: 说下去。 shuō xiàqu: go on (talking)
cards.Notes: 下 down + 去 go = go down (away from the speaker). After verbs: keep on going.

cards.Example: 他很有力。 tā hěn yǒu lì: he's strong
cards.Notes: Pictograph of a plough or a strong arm. Lookalikes: 力 lì strength vs 刀 dāo knife.

cards.Example: 团结就是力量。 tuánjié jiù shì lìliang: unity is strength
cards.Notes: 力 strength + 量 amount = amount of strength → power. 量 is liàng on its own.

cards.Example: 我失去了工作。 wǒ shīqù le gōngzuò: I lost my job
cards.Notes: 失 lose + 去 go away = lose. Lookalikes: 失 shī, 夫 fū, 矢 shǐ.

cards.Example: 我压力很大。 wǒ yālì hěn dà: I'm under a lot of stress
cards.Notes: 压 press (厂 + 土 earth) + 力 force = pressing force → pressure.

cards.Example: 我同意。 wǒ tóngyì: I agree
cards.Notes: 同 same + 意 idea = same idea → agree.

cards.Example: 我本来想去。 wǒ běnlái xiǎng qù: I originally wanted to go
cards.Notes: 本 root, origin + 来 come = from the origin → originally.

cards.Example: 我基本上懂了。 wǒ jīběnshang dǒng le: I basically get it
cards.Notes: 基 foundation (土 earth + 其 qí for the sound) + 本 root = foundation → basic.

cards.Example: 开学以来我很忙。 kāixué yǐlái wǒ hěn máng: I've been busy since term started
cards.Notes: 以 from, by + 来 come = from then on → since. Goes after the time: …以来.

cards.Example: 这个地区很冷。 zhège dìqū hěn lěng: this region is cold
cards.Notes: 地 land + 区 district = region.

cards.Meaning: to follow closely; to pay attention to
cards.Example: 谢谢关注！ xièxie guānzhù: thanks for following!
cards.Notes: 关 concern + 注 focus = keep attention on. Also "follow" on social media.

cards.Example: 这件衣服很适合你。 zhè jiàn yīfu hěn shìhé nǐ: this outfit really suits you
cards.Notes: 适 suit (辶 + 舌) + 合 fit, match = suitable.

cards.Example: 我从来不喝酒。 wǒ cónglái bù hē jiǔ: I never drink
cards.Notes: 从 from + 来 come = from the past until now. With 不/没 = never.

cards.Example: 他的普通话很标准。 tā de pǔtōnghuà hěn biāozhǔn: his Mandarin is very standard
cards.Notes: 标 mark + 准 accurate = an accurate mark → standard.

cards.Example: 比赛很精彩！ bǐsài hěn jīngcǎi: the match was brilliant!
cards.Notes: 精 refined, excellent + 彩 colour (彡 brush strokes) = finely coloured → brilliant.

cards.Example: 这是他的作品。 zhè shì tā de zuòpǐn: this is his work
cards.Notes: 作 make + 品 article, item (three 口) = a made item → work of art.

cards.Example: 我的表不准。 wǒ de biǎo bù zhǔn: my watch isn't accurate
cards.Notes: 冫 + 隹 zhuī (bird) for the sound. In 准备 prepare, 标准 standard, 不准 not allowed.

cards.Example: 他是中文系的。 tā shì Zhōngwén xì de: he's in the Chinese department
cards.Notes: 丿 + 糸 silk = threads tied together → link, system. jì: 系鞋带 tie shoelaces.

cards.Example: 下面请他讲。 xiàmiàn qǐng tā jiǎng: next, let's hear from him
cards.Notes: 下 below + 面 side = underside. Also "next, following". Often said xiàmian.

cards.Example: 他突然消失了。 tā tūrán xiāoshī le: he suddenly disappeared
cards.Notes: 消 melt away (氵 water + 肖 xiào for the sound) + 失 lose = fade and be lost → disappear.
